newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The government has postponed a meeting, the second this week, originally scheduled for Wednesday. Data required to debate the budget revision were not completely drawn up. The meeting is to be held on Thursday.
* Road transport trade union Star has staged a protest in central Bucharest on Wednesday when some 200 vans and trucks paraded on the streets, sounding their horns.

The unionists demanded withdrawal of a road tax due to be introduced on August 1. They said they feared the government would use the money raised from these taxes for purposes other than road repairs.
* Floods receded across the country, with meteorologists saying weather conditions had improved over the past 24 hours.
